segments.en: Elokim is the Sefira that brings forth Zu"n [Zeir Anpin and Nukva — the "masculine" and "feminine" aspects of divinity in the supernal realm] — "the heavens and the earth." Therefore it says "bara" (created), for Ima [the Divine Mother — the Sefira of Bina, identified with Elokim] dwells and nests within the act of creation.

segments.he: נקבץ במק וםאחד והוא סוד השפע הבא לע ולם ,ומצד הגב ורה שממ נה נעש ים הסיתומים נעש יתה יבשה .ונכפל בו״כיט וב״ ,לפ ישביוםב׳ נברא ג יהנם , כמ״שר ז״ל .לפ ישגיהנם הוא ח ושך הנ ולד מן הגב ורה ,ולכך כיוםב׳ שהוא סודגב ורה נברא בוג יהנם .אבל לפישיכוללהיותאיזהפגטבגב ורה לפי שממ נה נברא ג יהנם ,לכך ביוםג׳ נכפל בו״כיט וב״ ,שהוא סודהת״ת המתק ן הגב ורה ומעב ירממנהכלח ושך [ .א]
segments.en: The Sages taught: the word את (es) comes to include their offspring. They likewise taught that among the things that preceded the creation of the world is the Name of Mashiach. On this basis we may say that this verse speaks of Melech HaMashiach — the King Messiah. It is known that Mashiach ben Dovid has his root in Tiferes and Malchus [the sixth and tenth Sefiros — harmony/beauty and kingship]. Therefore Scripture says: "In the beginning G-d created the heavens" — the word את comes to include Melech HaMashiach, whose root extends into both "the heavens" (Tiferes) and "the earth" (Malchus).

segments.en: Of the King Mashiach it is said: "He was wounded for our transgressions" [Isaiah 53:5] — and this corresponds to his aspect of Malchus. Just as Malchus goes into exile, so too his soul goes with her. But this is in the aspect of Malchus alone. Therefore Scripture says: "And the earth was tohu va-vohu" — these are the four klippos [husks / forces of impurity] through which the Shechina and Mashiach wander.

segments.en: But his aspect of Tiferes — "the spirit of G-d" — the word רוח (ruach, spirit) — is specifically the secret of Tiferes, which issues forth from Ima, who is called Elokim. And this, on the contrary — "hovers over the face of the waters" — illuminates that portion of Mashiach's soul that is within those turbulent waters. For not all of his soul goes into exile, but only a certain luminosity — that which is in the aspect of Malchus — while his aspect of Tiferes fortifies and sustains her. And מרחפת (merachefes) is [an anagram of] תפח מר — "cause the bitter to burst."

segments.en: And at the end of days, at the time of the Tikkun (rectification), Ima is revealed and does not withdraw from Him. She says: "Let there be light" — desiring that the soul of Mashiach emerge into the open. And this occurs when the Shechina also emerges from the klippos. And יהי (yehi) equals in numerical value כ״ה (25) — which is the Shechina, who is called כה (Koh).

segments.en: At that time she will be אור (Or) — light — unlike during the exile when it is said of her: "Do not look upon me, for I am dark" [Song of Songs 1:6]. And during the exile it is said: "I shall not enter the heavenly Jerusalem" etc., for there can be no complete union (zivug) above, in truth, unless there is also one below, between Zu"n. Therefore it says: "And G-d saw" — Abba [the Divine Father — Chachma], who is in the secret of sight (re'iya), and Elokim which is Ima — they unite in wholeness, because there is union below. Therefore it says: "That the light was good" — טוב (tov, good) is Yesod [the ninth Sefira — the channel of divine flow], which couples with Malchus, called "light," at the time of the Tikkun. Whereas in the time of blemish, G-d forbid, she is called "dark," as stated.

segments.en: Then Ima is revealed to perform the birur (clarification / extraction of holy sparks): "And G-d separated between the light" — which is the Shechina — "and between the darkness" — which is the klipa. Unlike in the time of exile, when, G-d forbid, it appears as though there is no distinction, since she is submerged within them. And this is the first birur — extracting food (ochel) from waste (psoles). But a second birur is needed — removing waste from within food — so that the good that is mixed within the klipa may enter into holiness.

segments.he: -הט ובשיש בקל יפה הנתק ןבתיקון הרא וי .ולכך נאים מעש יה
segments.en: Therefore: "And to the darkness He called 'night' [לַיְלָה]" — for if He had called it לֵיל (lail), it would indicate ruin in which no further clarification is possible. But He calls it לַיְלָה (layla) — with the additional ה — to indicate that some good is still intermingled there requiring extraction. And once the waste is expelled, the food enters into holiness, and then: "And there was evening and there was morning, one day" — all in wholeness. MS A
"And G-d said: Let the waters be gathered…" [Genesis 1:9]

segments.he: ״כקט ורת״ ,שש נ יהם מינ יבירור ,להעל ותהתיקון כרא וי [ .א]
segments.en: At first the waters were spread over the entire earth, and afterward they were gathered to one place. This is the secret of Eden. The earth is the secret of Malchus. And at first the waters were over all of it. This was an allusion to the fact that all the dimensions of Malchus were filled with shefa (divine abundance) to bring to the world. But in this state the created beings could not endure — just as it is impossible for the world to stand upon absolute evil, so too it is impossible to sustain upon the abundance of absolute good. Therefore one portion of Malchus was filled with waters — that is the secret of the flow of influence — so that it would never be lacking to the world. And another portion of Malchus would become dry land — meaning its lights would be sealed — so that the world could endure. But nevertheless even this dry portion, were it permanent, would be impossible to sustain. Therefore this portion too must receive occasional flow, and this is the secret of the rains that come upon the earth. Yet excessive rain flooding the entire world is not good — the world could not endure it — and this is the mystery of the Flood: from an excess of abundance, destruction came.

segments.en: Furthermore, there is another reason for this arrangement. The things that were done in this lower world allude to the supernal luminaries. At first the lights entered the vessels and the vessels shattered from the intensity of the illumination. Therefore the world of Tikkun was needed — that the vessel expand and the light diminish. So too below: at first the entire world was filled with water — an allusion to the great illumination that existed originally, which the world could not endure. Afterward the waters gathered — an allusion to the light — and the dry land appeared, alluding to the vessel that expanded and in which the light was then sealed.

חיזקואותוב נקבה שהיא בסוד ומח״ל
segments.en: And all this was done by Ima — just as she rectified the seven lower Sefiros above, so she rectified the heavens and earth below in all their offspring, for they are the secret of Zu"n — and it is all one matter. This is the secret of: "And G-d said: Let the waters be gathered" — אלהים specifically, which is Ima. And this was done on the third day, which is the secret of Tiferes, the secret of the joining of Chesed and Gevura together. From the side of Chesed, the waters gathered to one place — the secret of the abundance coming to the world; from the side of Gevura, from which the "sealings" are made, the dry land was formed. And the phrase "it is good" is doubled on this day, because on the second day Gehinnom was created, as our Sages taught — for Gehinnom is the darkness born of Gevura. Therefore on the second day, whose secret is Gevura, Gehinnom was created. But lest there be some flaw attributed to Gevura on that account, on the third day the phrase "it is good" is doubled — for Tiferes is the secret that rectifies Gevura and removes all darkness from it. segments.en: It is already known that Noach and the Taiva (ark) represent the mystical union of Yesod and Malchus together. [The word taiva also means "word" — the ark is the vessel that holds all living potential, as Malchus does in the supernal realm.] This is why the Holy One, Blessed is He, said to him: "Come, you and all your household, into the ark" — it is fitting for you to be united with Malchus, which is the Taiva, since you embody the aspect of Yesod. And this is what He said to him: "For I have seen you as a tzaddik" — specifically a tzaddik, which is the secret of Yesod, as is known, and as explained in the Zohar there.

segments.en: And there is here a mystical secret concerning what the Sages taught: that Og swore to Noach that he would be his servant forever, and through this he was saved — and Noach made one hole in the ark and through it provided him with his food. Noach embodies Yesod. Og is the klipa that stands behind it, as is known. And when the klipa subjugates itself to holiness, it should not be destroyed — on the contrary, the Tikkun is precisely that it exist as a servant. Therefore when Og subjugated himself to Noach, this signified that the klipa that stands behind Yesod was subjugated to Yesod. Therefore there was salvation for Og through Noach.

segments.en: And because the Sitra Achra [lit. "the Other Side" — the realm of impurity], even when it is subjugated, should not be brought inside holiness — only to remain outside as a servant, with holiness sustaining it from without just enough for its life — therefore Noach did not bring Og into the ark but fed him only from outside.

segments.en: It then says: "Of all the animals…" etc. It is already known that the generation of the Flood existed under the aspect of the "breaking of the vessels" (sheviras ha-keilim). And Noach embodies the world of Tikkun, and the rectification of the worlds comes through the mystical union of מ״ה (M"H = 45) and ב״ן (B"N = 52) [two modes of the Divine Name Yud-Heh-Vav-Heh — M"H is associated with the human soul; B"N with the animal / lower kingdom]. Therefore the Holy One wished to preserve in the world a species of human — under the secret of the Name מ״ה — which was Noach and his sons — and a species of animal — under the secret of the Name ב״ן, for the word בהמה (behema — animal) totals B"N in its letters.

segments.he: ראויה ,שהר י הוא בעמ ודא דאמצע יתא נשרש ,ושם יש אהבה שמתחב רים ימין ושמא ל כאחד .והנה אמר ו :כל אהבה שהיא תלויהבדבר בטל דבר בטלה אהבה ,וכל שאינהתלויה בדבר א ינה בט ילה לע ולם ,א יזו אהבה שהיא תלויה בדב רזהו אהבת אמנ ון ותמר ,ואהבה שאינהתלויהבדברזוהי אהבת דוד ו יהונת ן .והנה ״דבר״ היא השכ ינה ,והאהבה ה זאת צר יכה לעל ותממנהבסוד התע ורר ותה נקבה עד לגב י המלך ,וא זתע ורר אהבת ו .ו זהו אהבת דוד ,שהוא במדר יגת השכ ינה ,ל יה ונת ן ,שהוא במדר יגת המלך — יה ו־נת ן .אב ליש לפעמ יםשגםהס״אמ בקשת להת דבק בשכ ינה שהיא מדר יגתדוד .וכל כך למה ,אלא מפנ יש נשמת וה יתה מל ובשת בקל יפת מ ואב כידוע .ועל כן יצא ממנו אמנ ון ,שס ודו — מןאון ,שהר יהיהבא ממדר יגתאוןבן פלת ש רצה לקטר ג נגד משה ,וע״כ גם בעת דוד קטר גאל תמר ,ס ודזה ,הס ״א שר וצה להתדבק בשכ ינה .אבל מפנ י שהיא אהבה שהיא תלויה בדבר ,וא ינה באה מן הדבר ,שהר יתמרלא רצתה .מפ ניזהבטל דבר בטלה אהבה .שהר ימיד השכ ינה מסתלקת לאי׳ [ וא ינה ] נמצאת עוד ,כמ ודברשאובד ובטל .ועל כן : ״מ יםרביםלאי וכל ו לכב ותאת האהבה״ .כ יהס״א — ״ יתפרד וכלפ ועל י און״ שהוא און ,והם נפרד ים ,ולפ יכך :״מ יםרב ים״ . ועוד :שמפ נישאין אהבה משת רשת אלא במדר יגת יעקב עמ ודא דאמצע יתא ,ב ג״ד האומותהע ולם ,שבא יםמימיןבסוד ישמעאל — ,״מ ים רב ים״ ,וא ותם שבא יםמצד שמא לבסודעשו — ״ ונהר ות״ ,כ יהרי השמא ל נקשר באי׳ש נקראת נהר .לא זה ולא זהיכוללשלוטעל האהבה ,מפנ י שהיא ל יעקב נ יתנה ,במדר יגה דעמ ודא דאמצע יתא ,״תת ן אמת ל יעקב״ ,״מ יםרבים לאי וכל ו לכב ותאת האהבה ונהר ותלא ישטפ וה״ ,ודא י .
segments.en: And this is the secret of why He commanded there be seven of each pure kind — corresponding to the seven lower Sefiros that were shattered. He commanded they go in "a man and his wife" (ish ve-ishto) — for all the original blemish came from the failure of male and female to be properly united, and the Tikkun was precisely their union in the secret of male and female. Therefore specifically "a man and his wife." MS A

segments.he: והנה אע״ ג שהס ״א נ ותנת כל מדר יגותאומותהע ולם כנגד הקד ושה , בזמן גוג ,כד יל ינק מן האהבה ה זאת ,אבל אינוע ולה ב ידה .אלא אד רבא : ״ב וזיבוזולו״ ,כ ימה שהוא בא לקחת מן הקד ושןה ] הוא נלקח ממנה ,כ י הוא נותןאתכלהוןביתו באהבה ,ובאהבה [ה זאת ] ממש נשא רלכוד ,בס וד הבירורים האחר וניםש יתתק נואז.וזה :״ב וזיבוזולו״ ,ב ׳ וז׳ שע ולה כחשב ון אהבה ,״יבוזולו״ מלש וןביזה .ובג״ד :״ו יאהב יעקב את רחל ״ יעקב ולא אחר [את מי ] הוא א והב ,אלא עקרת הבית .ע יקרם שלבית ,ובעב ורה הוא ר וצה בעב ודת הז׳ימיםשלהע ולם הזה .למה .אלא :״ברחל בתך הקט נה״ , בגץ ההיא נק ודה קטנה דאת ל בשת בגוקליפין .ס ודזה :״ ורב יעב ודצע יר״ . שעש וש ולט על יעקב ,אבל אינו אלא להגביר האהבה ה זאת שלקב״ה לגב י
segments.en: Malki-Tzedek embodies Yesod de-Abba [the Yesod aspect within Abba — the Divine Father / Chachma], as stated — and through him Malchus was rectified, in the mystical dimension of: "Hashem through wisdom founded the earth" [Proverbs 3:19]. Therefore he is called מלכי צדק — "King of Righteousness" — for he brings tzedek (Malchus) to its rectification. And since he stands within Abba, and Abba and Ima (א״ו״א) are never separated from one another in all the worlds — therefore: "He brought out bread and wine" — לחם (lechem, bread) alludes to the three Divine Names (Havayos) that issue from Abba; יין (yayin, wine) alludes to Ima [yayin = 70 = Sod — hidden wisdom, the level of Bina / Ima].

segments.he: שכ ינתא ,״ו יאהב יעקב את רחל״ ,״מ יםרביםלאי וכל ו לכב ותאת האהבה״ , ודא י . ועוד :ו יאהב יעקב את רחל וגו׳ .מ יםרביםלאי וכל ו לכב ותאת האהבה וגו /בא וראה ,ישראל למטה נעש ים [בס יס ] לקב״ה ושכ ינת יה ,ובכחם הקב״ה מתחב רעם השכ ינה ,כ יהם לקש רבין קב״ה ושכ ינת יה .הה ״ד : ״אהבת י אתכם״ ,כל ומר בכחכם אנכ יא והב .למ י ,אלא לשכ ינה ודא י . ״ ואמרתם במה אהבת נו״ — אם תבקש ו[מובן ] לזה ,״הלא אחעשול יעקב״ , כיגםעשו הוא בת״ת ,וגם בוהיהיכול להעש ותקשר האהבה .אבל עכ״ זלא רצה הקב״ה אלא ב ישראל ,״וא והב את יעקב״ ,את די יקא .וע״כ ל יעקב נאה לאה ובאת רחל ,הוא ולא אחר ,ודא י . ו יעקב — לעב ודעודז׳ימים שהם ז׳ ימותהחול ,ואחר יששבתמנ וחה , ״אעבדך שבעשנים ברחל בתך הקטנה״ .״ו יאהב״ הוא אב יהוא ,ס ודו :אהבה ו״ה ,ו׳ רח ימת לה׳ה׳רח ימת לו׳ .ע״כ :״מ יםרביםלאי וכל ו לכב ותאת האהבה״ ,ס וד אלה ״מ יםרב ים״ הוא תשע מאות רכב ברזל .דס יטרא דמים הז ידונ ים .מ יםמאינון זידונים .והם מיםרבים מפנ ישאין בהם שוםיחוד .למה המים האלה א ינם מכב יםאת האהבה .אלא מפנ י שהיא נשמ רתמאי׳ — ״ ונהר ותלא ישטפ וה״ ,ס וד נהר — מאי׳ ,ג ורם שלא ישטפ וה .ס ודזה ״רשפ יה רשפ יאשש להבת יה״ — יק שהם א ו״א הש ומר יםאת השכ ינה .והם ״ב וז״ נקרא ו ,שע ולה לחשב ון י״ק ,ב ג״ד :ב וז
segments.en: "And he was a priest to G-d Most High (אל עליון)" — because he stands within Abba and draws down illumination from Arich Anpin (א״א) [the all-encompassing aspect of divinity, "the Long-Face"] — through the secret of אל עליון — which is the first Tikkun of the Supernal Beard (Dikna Ila'a). And he drew that illumination down to Avraham, and this is the meaning of: "Blessed is Avram to G-d Most High" — this is the first Tikkun of the Beard. "Possessor of heaven and earth" — this is the final Tikkun, drawn from the totality of the Beard. "And blessed is G-d Most High" — through this, the Supernal Name triumphed over His enemies.

segments.en: "And he gave him a tithe of all" — Malchus is united with Yesod below, and this is the secret of "a tithe of all." And when he gave the tithe to the Divine Name — which is in the dimension of Chachma — he elevated Malchus upward into Chachma to complete her rectification, in the dimension of: "Hashem through wisdom founded the earth." segments.en: The mystical secret of Ur Kasdim ["Ur of the Chaldees" — the fiery furnace of Nimrod] is this: It is already known that the perfection of the Tikkun is when Chesed (lovingkindness) reigns and Gevura (judgment) stands beneath it. And if it is reversed, the Sitra Achra gains strength and the nations of the world rule. Therefore the wicked Nimrod thought to strengthen Gevura over Chesed by casting Avraham — who is from the side of Chesed — into fire, which is the aspect of Gevura. Had he been burned in the fire, Chesed would have remained subjugated to Din (judgment), and the Sitra Achra would have gained enormous power from that act. But the Holy One reversed it for good — Avraham overcame the fire, and Chesed conquered Din. This was the first trial, because it represents the first and root Tikkun — the foundation of all the rectifications that need to be made: to strengthen Chesed over Din. And when Chesed holds sway, all things travel in the path of Tikkun — holiness rules, Israel dwells on their land and holds dominion. Therefore the matter of Ur Kasdim is bound to [the inheritance of] the Land of Israel, as it says: "To give you this land to inherit it."

segments.en: Afterward he asked Him: "How shall I know?" — meaning, by what merit? He answered him: by the merit of the sacrificial offerings, as our Sages taught. And the explanation is: the Land of Israel is the secret of Malchus, and as long as Malchus stands below, the klippos draw sustenance from her — G-d forbid. The Tikkun is therefore to elevate her ever higher, for then the klippos cannot hold her. This was the power of the sacrifices — they elevated Malchus, as is explained in the commentary on Parshas Tzav. Therefore by the merit of the sacrifices Israel stands on its land, for the sacrifices cause Malchus to ascend on high — and the Land of Israel below ascends with her — and thus the nations of the world have no dominion over the Land of Israel.

segments.en: The Sages furthermore explained that the Holy One showed Avraham the future kingdoms — and the meaning is: the Holy One wished to precede the cure to the wound. Avraham, upon seeing the kingdoms, would surely direct his intention to subjugate them. And before those kings came to rule the world, they were subjugated at the outset — and this caused their eventual rule to be impermanent. Therefore the Holy One showed them to him first — to subjugate them and to raise the Tikkun as it should be. MS A

segments.en: Sodom and Amora are the Zu"n of the klipa [the "masculine" and "feminine" forces of impurity, mirroring the holy Zu"n] and they were stirred up to prosecute against the holy Zu"n. This is called a ze'aka (outcry / indictment) — a great upheaval, G-d forbid, when they are stirred to prosecute even against the "male" above. Therefore it says: ה׳ — Hashem — specifically ה׳, which is Ze'ir Anpin: "the outcry of Sodom and Amora is great [כי רבה]" — for the accusation reached even the zachar (male), G-d forbid. And this is the meaning of כי רבה: רב refers to Tiferes, in the dimension of: "Rav chesed" — abundant in lovingkindness [Exodus 34:6]. And the ה is the female. Meaning the accusation reached both of them. "And their sin — for it is exceedingly heavy" — this "sin" is the Sitra Achra, in the dimension of: "sin crouches at the door" [Genesis 4:7] — it pressed down heavily against holiness, like a heavy stone. And it was necessary for Ze'ir Anpin himself to descend into the midst of the klippos to extract the clarifications — just as will happen in the future age as well. This is the meaning of: "I shall go down now and see" — go down specifically into the klippos to perform the birur. And this is also the meaning of: "the cry that has come to me" — to me specifically — for the accusation reached Him.

segments.en: Avraham interceded greatly on their behalf. He first asked: "If there should be fifty righteous ones" — to arouse the power of Ima, who is the "Gate of Fifty" [the fifty gates of Bina], to cause all the blemishes to pass away. Then he asked: if there were מ״ה (45) — in the dimension of Ze'ir Anpin, who is the Name מ״ה — so that through the merit of those righteous ones all blemishes would pass. Then he asked: if there were forty — for the rectification of the complete Merkava (divine chariot), in the dimension of חגת״ם [Chesed, Gevura, Tiferes, Malchus]. And if not — then at least thirty, in the dimension of חג״ת [Chesed, Gevura, Tiferes] — which are the essential ones, with Malchus automatically included with them. Then he asked: if there were twenty — for the rectification of Zu"n in their general totality. And afterward — ten, for the rectification of holiness in its entirety in the dimension of the ten Sefiros, if specific rectification were not possible. And since not even this was present, the Holy One destroyed them — to remove the wicked from the earth and to raise the Tikkun as it should be. MS A

segments.en: Sodom and Amora are the Zu"n of the klipa, and they were stirred up to prosecute against the holy Zu"n, G-d forbid. This is called a ze'aka — a great upheaval, G-d forbid, when they are stirred to prosecute even against the male. Therefore it says: ה׳ specifically, who is Ze'ir Anpin — "the outcry of Sodom and Amora is great" — for the accusation reached even the male, G-d forbid. The secret of "for it is great [כי רבה]" is: רב ה׳ — and רב is Tiferes, in the dimension of: ורב חסד — abundant in lovingkindness, inclining toward Chesed. And the ה is the female. So the accusation reached both of them.

segments.en: "And their sin — for it is exceedingly heavy" — this sin is the Sitra Achra, in the dimension of: "sin crouches at the door" — and it is the Sitra Achra that seizes Yesod, for then they had a great grip, because Yesod emitted there [the impurity of] keri [involuntary seminal emission — a kabbalistic concept relating to sacred energy falling into the impure realm], G-d forbid. "For it is heavy [כי כבדה]" — in the dimension of: "for the mouth is heavy [כי כבד פה]" [Exodus 4:10] — for Yesod is called "mouth" (פה).

segments.en: Therefore it was necessary for Ze'ir Anpin himself to descend into the midst of the klippos to extract the clarifications — just as will also happen in the future. And of Ze'ir Anpin it is said: "A prisoner cannot free himself from the house of bondage" [i.e., He needed external means — the next passage continues this but was cut off in the manuscript]. And it was necessary — [that the good within the klipa be rectified with the proper rectification]. Therefore their deeds are described as being "like incense" — for both [the birur and the tikkun] are types of clarification, to raise the Tikkun as it should be. MS A

segments.en: This entire parasha is explained allegorically as referring to the war of Mashiach ben Yosef with Gog. Yitzchak embodies the secret of Mashiach ben Yosef, who is Din (judgment), and he is the son of Mashiach ben Dovid — in the dimension of Avraham who is Chesed, as is known from the [Zoharic] teaching: "from darkness — light" (מאן אעדר ואוליד חשוכא). Therefore: "son of Avraham." Furthermore: "son of Avraham" — as a son stands under his father, so too Mashiach ben Yosef stands under Mashiach ben Dovid, for the son of Yishai (Dovid) is at the head.

segments.en: "And Yitzchak was forty years old" — the secret of the matter is that afterward he must be included within the Supernal Merkava, which is חגת״ם [Chesed, Gevura, Tiferes, Malchus] — all of them illuminating through the power of Malchus — so that she can exact vengeance from the nations of the world. This is [the meaning of] "forty years." And then the Shechina is taken with him, and this is: "when he took Rivka."

segments.en: It is known that the Dikna [the Beard — the hidden channels of divine grace in Arich Anpin] will be aroused in the future to subdue the external forces. The first rectification is אל (El), and this is: "daughter of Besuel" — the daughter of אל — Malchus receiving illumination from the Supernal אל. And Mashiach ben Yosef takes Malchus in this aspect to exact vengeance from the nations. And because there is another אל below, in the lower Dikna of Ze'ir Anpin, therefore it says: "the Aramean" — from the root רם (exalted) — indicating that specifically the supernal אל must be aroused.

segments.he: וגו׳ (מח ,ז־ט ) .אמר ור ז״ל :בשב ילש יעקב
segments.en: "From Padan Aram" — Malchus is sealed in exile and will then open. This is the secret of מפדן ארם: Malchus becomes open through the two אלs that are in the Dikna of Arich Anpin that illuminate upon her. Then she becomes "sister of Lavan the Aramean" — the secret being: there are two wisdoms: supernal Chachma and lower Chachma. And when the two אלs illuminate upon the lower wisdom, she too rises to the level of supernal wisdom — which is the supreme whiteness (lavan) — which is pure Chesed. This is: "sister of Lavan the Aramean." And Mashiach ben Yosef takes her with all these rectifications — and this is: "to him as a wife." And this is only the preparation for the redemption — so that when he subsequently fights Gog he will have the power to stand.

segments.en: Now the verse speaks of the whole matter in detail. "And Yitzchak pleaded…for his wife was barren" — Malchus is called barren in exile, for she cannot bring forth her own lights. All this is because Tiferes has distanced itself from her. The Tikkun is that Yesod arouse Tiferes to draw near to Malchus and channel illumination to her. This is: "And Yitzchak pleaded" — for we have said that Yitzchak is Mashiach ben Yosef and he embodies Yesod as is known. The secret of Yitzchak also within Yesod is in the dimension of קץ חי (keitz chai — end of life / living end) [a kabbalistic epithet for Yesod]. He arouses the Name הוי״ה of the Holy One, Blessed is He, that stands within Tiferes of Ze'ir Anpin. This is: "And Yitzchak pleaded to Hashem."

segments.en: All this is: "opposite his wife" — his wife specifically — for currently there is no union (zivug) between them and they are back-to-back (אחור באחור — אב״א). He desires union face-to-face (פנים בפנים), therefore he arouses Tiferes. And immediately: "And Hashem responded to him, and Rivka his wife conceived" — the soul of Mashiach gestates within her. And note: there is no gestation without clarification (birur). The matter is: excess matter (mosros) must be expelled from the embryo, and this is what causes the suffering of pregnancy.

segments.en: Because Mashiach had been within the klipa, it was therefore necessary for him to gestate in order to expel the darkness that had clung to him — and this darkness is literally Gog. However, while it is still in the womb, it is not yet called by the name Eisav or Gog — only the impure aspect (זוהמא). But it prosecutes against the embryo — and this is literally the suffering of pregnancy. This is: "And the children struggled within her." But afterward "they called his name Eisav" — for as long as it is only mosros (surplus/waste), it is clarified and expelled and does not yet merit a name. Only when it emerges does it truly become Eisav — as will be explained further, with G-d's help.

segments.en: Then Malchus says: "If so, why am I thus?" — what purpose is served by the action of Yesod, which is "this" (זה) — better to remain as before than to endure this suffering. And she herself arouses Ze'ir Anpin to help her — and this is: "And she went to seek Hashem."

"And Hashem said to her: Two nations are in your womb." The explanation is: in the inner dimension (pnimiyus) of Nukva [the feminine aspect / Malchus] there is no exile — exile exists only in the external dimension (chitzoniyus). And two great illuminations are needed to strengthen it, for without them the klippos would draw very much from it, G-d forbid. These are Tiferes and Yesod, which uphold Nukva. And Nukva fears that these two illuminations will be withdrawn from her throughout the length of the exile. Therefore the first word [of G-d] says to her: "Two nations are in your womb" — in the dimension of: "Israel is one nation in the earth" [II Samuel 7:23] — these two "nations" (גויים) are Tiferes and Yesod, who guard this womb — the external dimension — throughout the entire exile.

And this will cause: "And two peoples shall be separated from your innards" — these are the two aspects found within her: the embryo and the expelled surplus that goes outside — each going its own way, one toward good and one toward evil. "And one people shall be stronger than the other" — because first holiness must strengthen itself greatly. Then the Sitra Achra serves her — and this is: "and one people shall be stronger than the other people" — the strengthening of holiness. And afterward: "and the elder shall serve the younger" — the Sitra Achra is the "elder" (רב), in the dimension of "the klipa that precedes the fruit" — shall serve holiness.

Afterward it is written: "And the days were fulfilled…and the first one came out" etc. — first the surplus comes out in the dimension of "the klipa that precedes the fruit." "And the first one came out ruddy [אדמוני]." The secret is: of Dovid it is said: "he was ruddy with beautiful eyes" [I Samuel 16:12] — in the dimension of Malchus, which is Din. And corresponding to this there is also a Nukva of the klipa who is likewise called אדמוני, in the dimension of: "G-d made one corresponding to the other" [Ecclesiastes 7:14] — except one is holy Din and one is impure Din. Therefore it came out ruddy — for it attached itself to the Nukva of the klipa. And it came out "like a hairy garment [כאדרת שער]" — the secret being: Malchus is called "gate" (שער), which is Din, and the Sitra Achra is called "hairy garment" (אדרת שער), for it is like a garment upon her. Then: "And they called his name Eisav" — for then they join and become one body. He is called עשו ("Eisav") from the root of עשייה (action/doing) — for in the klipa, the female dominates over the male. Therefore they strengthened him with the female, which is the dimension of action.

Scripture says "and they called" in the plural — in the dimension of: "Let all workers of iniquity be scattered" [Psalms 92:10]. Afterward Mashiach ben Yosef emerges — "and his hand grasping the heel of Eisav" — the Sitra Achra has a hold upon the lower rungs (עקביים) of holiness. Corresponding to this, Mashiach ben Yosef must go through all the parts of the klipa even to its lowest rungs, to take from it every good portion. Therefore: "his hand grasping the heel of Eisav" — and this is the secret of "in the footsteps of Mashiach" [בעקבות משיחא] — that he must subdue those "heels" (lowest points). "And his name was called Yaakov" — the Holy One calls him Yaakov in the secret of the divine unification, so that he be strengthened in this Tikkun.

"And Yitzchak was sixty years old when they were born" — the Shechina brought them forth through the power of the Gevura of Yitzchak — but encompassing all six extremities (shesh ketzavos). For with Gevura alone the external forces would draw from it, but with Gevura sweetened by the illumination of all six extremities, Gog is subdued under it and Mashiach ben Yosef is strengthened through it to subdue him.

"And the lads grew" — each grows and strengthens in his own aspect, one toward the good and one toward evil. "And Eisav was a man skilled in hunting" — he sought to "hunt" the lights of holiness. "A man of the field" — for they strengthened him with the Nukva of the klipa, which is the "field of Edom," as mentioned above. But Yaakov — whose secret is Mashiach ben Yosef as stated — "a wholesome man" — he does not desire the darkness of the klipa as Eisav desires to "hunt" the lights of holiness. All his desire is to receive illumination from the two feminine aspects of holiness — which are Leah and Rachel. This is: "dwelling in tents." And when Mashiach sees that Eisav has some of this "hunting" — some vestige of truth from holiness — he shows him flattery, in the dimension of: "with the crooked you shall be subtle" [Psalms 18:27] — to extract those sparks from him. But the Shechina watches over him so that no stumbling befalls him and he does not fall into Eisav's hands, G-d forbid.

There are many names for Mashiach — each according to his function. He is called Yitzchak — from the aspect of Gevura. Also because he is in Yesod, which is called Yitzchak in the dimension of קץ חי as is known. And Yesod is the clarifier — and when Yesod gives birth to the soul of Mashiach — meaning gives him the power to perform the birur — he is called "Yaakov" for the reason stated: he must go through all parts of the klipa even its lowest rungs to clarify them. This is: "Yitzchak loved Eisav for the hunt was in his mouth" — he deceives him to extract the sparks from him. But the Shechina watches over him that no stumbling occurs: "And Rivka loved Yaakov."

Two rectifications are needed: one — the birur, and this is: "his hand grasping the heel", as stated. And the second is the rectification of holiness, and this is: "and Yaakov cooked a stew [נזיד]" — food is only good when cooked. So too Yaakov — and he is Mashiach — "cooks" the lights of holiness, meaning he rectifies them. Afterward: "and Eisav came from the field and he was weary" — for already Mashiach had extracted from him the holy lights that had been sustaining him. So he says: give me some of this power from holiness. This is: "Pour for me some of this red, red [thing]" — from the aspect of Din, the root of the klipa, the place from which the external forces receive their vitality. And he doubles the word אדום ("red") twice — these are the two feminine aspects: Leah and Rachel — the places from which the external forces draw.

"For I am weary" — for he has nothing left. And Mashiach sees that he could arouse prosecution and prolong the matter, in the dimension of "the klipa that precedes the fruit" — therefore he says: it is better to give him a little so that the prosecution of the klipa-preceding-fruit not be aroused. Therefore he says to him: "Sell me today your birthright" — give him a little now, but he must surrender the rights of the firstborn. And Gog dismisses this, saying — the end of the klipa must come anyway, what does this early [concession] matter — this is: "Behold I am going to die" etc. Yaakov said to him: "Swear to me" — to strengthen the Tikkun. And he sold him the power of the birthright. And Mashiach gives him a little vitality — "bread and lentil stew" — until the time comes of which it is said: "He will swallow up death forever" [Isaiah 25:8] — the Sitra Achra will be utterly nullified, and holiness will be exalted forever and ever. MS A
"And Yitzchak dwelled and dug…" [Genesis 26:18–24]

The secret of the wells that were dug in the days of Avraham is this: because Avraham is from the side of Chesed, and through him it was fitting that Chesed spread through the world — and to signify this matter they dug wells of water, for water is from the aspect of Chesed, to show the spreading of Chesed that was fitting to spread through the world through him. Afterward the Philistines came and stopped them up — for this is the way of the Sitra Achra: to prevent Chesed from spreading. Yet they stopped them only after Avraham's death — for as long as he was alive he maintained the rectifications so they would not be nullified. And Yitzchak returned and dug them — meaning the assent of Gevura to the rectifications of Chesed. For when Gevura is not rectified, it prevents the rectifications of Chesed and seals the light. But when it is rectified, it actually assents to the rectifications of Chesed.

In order to show that Yitzchak was rectified Gevura, the Holy One arranged that Yitzchak would dig wells of water a second time — to show he was in the aspect of rectified Gevura, and thus assented to this rectification and the spreading of light. Therefore he gave them the same names his father had given them — for the secret of the name was already explained: to strengthen those rectifications that were made — showing that he maintained his father's rectifications. He named them the same names exactly. He dug two wells and they quarreled over them, because they were from the side of Avraham and Yitzchak, over whom the Sitra Achra has some hold — in the dimension of Eisav and Yishmael who came from them. But the third well — which was from the aspect of Yaakov whose heritage is complete — they did not quarrel over it. And since the purpose of digging the wells was to show that he was in the aspect of rectified Gevura, he therefore went up to Be'er Sheva which is Ima — for when Gevura is rectified it connects to Bina, its source. And there prophecy was revealed to him — for prophecy comes from Ima as is known. This is what is written: "I am the G-d of your father" — אנכי which is in Ima. And it says: "And I will bless you on account of Avraham my servant" — since he maintained his father's rectifications, he too was worthy of being blessed in the merit of his father. MS A
"Is it because his name is called Yaakov that he has deceived me twice…" [Genesis 27:36]

Yaakov intended to take the birthright and afterward the blessings from Eisav — to subdue the Sitra Achra with a complete subjugation. As G-d made "one corresponding to the other" — just as there are ten Sefiros of holiness, so there are ten Sefiros of the klipa. With the birthright he intended to subdue the "head" of the klipa, and with the blessings he subdued the "end" of the klipa — and thereby the "middle" was automatically subdued.

The explanation: the birthright is in the dimension of the "head" of holiness — once he acquired the birthright he received the power of the first Sefiros of holiness, and thereby automatically subdued the head of the klipa. And with the blessing he subdued the end. Malchus is called "blessing" (bracha) — she is the source of all blessings. When Yaakov received the blessings he drew the power of Malchus, from which all blessings flow — and thereby the Nukva of the klipa was automatically subdued beneath the Malchus of holiness — a handmaid beneath her mistress. Thus he subdued the head and end of the klipa, and the middle was thereby automatically subdued, and the klipa remained subordinate to holiness.

Nevertheless, Yitzchak did give Eisav some blessings afterward — because ultimately the klipa needs a certain share to receive its bare sustenance until the time arrives of which it is said: "And the idols shall utterly vanish" [Isaiah 2:18] — and holiness will be exalted in complete Tikkun. MS A
"And Yaakov went out [and vowed]…" [Genesis 28:20]

The Sages taught: all roads carry a presumption of danger. The secret is: "road" (derech) is Malchus, and from her side dangers flow, because the Sitra Achra seizes her. The Tikkun is therefore to draw the illumination of Ima. Therefore Yaakov, who needed to travel on the road — which is from the aspect of Malchus — drew the illumination of Ima. And this is in the secret of the vow, which is in Ima. The Sages said here: it is a mitzvah to make a vow in a time of distress. A "time of distress" is in Malchus, where distress resides. Therefore the Tikkun is to draw the illumination of Ima. Therefore Yaakov said here: "If G-d [Elokim] will be" — Elokim specifically, which is Ima — "and will guard me on the road" — for she is the guardian on roads.

"And will give me bread" — he asked for bread and clothing for his needs. But all the desires of righteous people — even what they ask for their own needs — are for the rectification of the supernal luminaries. The rectification of the supernal Sefiros depends precisely on bread and clothing. The secret is: the levels of holiness are divided into two: inner (pnimiyus) and outer (chitzoniyus). For the rectification of the inner dimension, bread is required; for the rectification of the outer dimension, clothing is required.

Bread is the food that enters the body's inner dimension and sustains it — and the soul too is sustained and nourished thereby. So too above: the influence that enters into the inner dimension of the Partzufim and sustains them — this is called "bread," for it performs literally the function of bread. And the secret of לחם (bread) is in the dimension of the three Divine Names — the inner dimension of the Sefiros, the Name of G-d that gives them life. And the outer dimension's rectification is to clothe it in garments — to protect it from the klippos. Therefore: "and will give me bread to eat" — for the rectification of the inner dimension; "and clothing to wear" — for the rectification of the outer dimension — to raise both rectifications as they should be. MS A

"And Yaakov loved Rachel and he said: I will serve you seven years for Rachel your younger daughter. Many waters cannot quench love, nor can rivers sweep it away; if a man were to give all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly scorned." [Genesis 29:18 and Song of Songs 8:7]

Come and see: the love of Yaakov is fitting, for he is rooted in the Middle Pillar (amuda de-emtzaisa) — and there love dwells, where Right and Left join together as one. The Sages taught: any love that depends on something — when the thing ceases, the love ceases; any love that does not depend on something — it never ceases. What is love that depends on something? The love of Amnon and Tamar. And love that does not depend on something? The love of Dovid and Yonasan. And "the thing" (davar) is the Shechina — this love must rise from her in the secret of the arousal of the feminine up before the King, and then arouses His love. This is the love of Dovid — who is at the level of the Shechina — for Yonasan — who is at the level of the King.

But sometimes the Sitra Achra also seeks to attach itself to the Shechina — which is the level of Dovid. And why? Because his soul was clothed in the klipa of Moav, as is known. Therefore from him came Amnon — whose secret is מן אוּן — for he was from the level of On ben Peles who sought to prosecute against Moshe. Therefore also in the time of Dovid [the Sitra Achra] prosecuted against Tamar — this being the Sitra Achra that seeks to attach to the Shechina. But since it is a love that depends on a thing and does not come from the thing itself — for Tamar did not consent — therefore when the thing ceases, the love ceases. For at once the Shechina withdraws to Ima and is no longer present — like a thing that is lost and nullified. Therefore: "Many waters cannot quench love." For the Sitra Achra — "let all workers of iniquity be scattered" — who is אוּן — they are scattered. Therefore: "many waters."

Furthermore: because love is only rooted in the level of Yaakov — the Middle Pillar — the nations of the world who come from the right side in the dimension of Yishmael — "many waters" — and those who come from the left side in the dimension of Eisav — "rivers" — for the left is connected to Ima, which is called "river" — neither of these can overpower love, because love was given to Yaakov, in the level of the Middle Pillar. "Give truth to Yaakov" [Micah 7:20]. "Many waters cannot quench love, nor can rivers sweep it away" — indeed.

And even though the Sitra Achra marshals all the levels of the nations of the world against holiness — at the time of Gog — in order to draw from this love, it will not succeed. On the contrary: "he would be utterly scorned" — for whatever it comes to take from holiness is taken from it, for it gives all the wealth of its house in [pursuit of] love, and in that very love it remains ensnared — in the dimension of the final clarifications (birurim) that will then be rectified. And this is: "he would be utterly scorned" — the two letters ב"ז equal the numerical value of אהבה (love) — "he would be scorned" in the sense of despoilment (biza).

Therefore: "And Yaakov loved Rachel" — Yaakov and no other. Whom does he love? None other than the "Mainstay of the House" (ikeres habayis). And for her sake he desires the seven days of service of this world. Why? Because: "Rachel your younger daughter" — in this dimension she is the small point, clothed within klipa shells. The secret of this is: "and the elder shall serve the younger" — Eisav rules over Yaakov, but this is only to intensify the love of the Holy One, Blessed is He, for the Shechina. "Many waters cannot quench love" — indeed.

Furthermore: Come and see — Israel below becomes a "base" (basis) for the Holy One and His Shechina, and through their power the Holy One unites with the Shechina — for they are the bond between the Holy One and His Shechina. This is the meaning of: "I have loved you" [Malachi 1:2] — meaning through your power I love. Whom? None other than the Shechina, indeed. "And you say: wherein have you loved us?" — if you seek to understand this — "was not Eisav a brother to Yaakov?" For Eisav too is in Tiferes, and through him too the bond of love could have been made. But nevertheless the Holy One desired only Israel. "And I loved Yaakov" — es specifically [implying the whole, the es includes the Shechina]. Therefore it is fitting for Yaakov to love Rachel — him and no other. Indeed. MS B
"And Yaakov went on his way…" [Genesis 33:2–3]

This is the secret of: ויחי חד מבית יעקב — for he will go on this road. And then: "And the angels of G-d met him" — and these are angels of G-d. For there are holy divine forces and there are other divine forces that seize upon them — and Yaakov needed to perform this birur: take the holy ones and separate them from the others. And this is through the power of Ima that joins with Nukva. And this is: "when he saw them" — the word כאשר: אשר is Ima, כאשר is Nukva and Ima, and וראם is also Ima — meaning ר׳ אֵם (the head of Ima). Then he said: "This is the camp of G-d" — what he had clarified in the secret of the holy divine forces. Then: "And he called that place Machanaim" — for it is the place of the division of the camps. MS B
Vayishlach
"And Yaakov sent angels…" [Genesis 32:4–5]

The Sages said here: literal angels. The secret is: the essential subjugation of the Sitra Achra is to subdue it in the place of its own dominion. Eisav's dominion was in the land of Seir, which was given to him as his portion — as it says: "I gave to Eisav Mount Seir to inherit it." Therefore Yaakov sent the angels there — for angels stand in the secret of Gevura, as is known, in the dimension of: "His ministers — flaming fire" [Psalms 104:4] — so that through the power of their Gevura they would subdue it specifically in the place of its dominion.

It then says: "And he commanded" etc. — the secret of this matter is that Yaakov subjugated himself to Eisav and called him "my lord" (adoni). Eisav was not entirely evil — there was also within him some aspect of good — and it suffices to say: that he came from Yitzchak. And in this dimension he also observed certain mitzvos — the mitzvah of honoring father and mother — because there was within him some aspect of good. And when Yaakov subjugated himself, his intention was to subjugate himself to the good portion within him. This too is the secret of: when he saw him, he bowed before him — as it says: "and he passed before them and bowed" — he intended to bow toward the good side within him.

Then it says: "With Lavan I have sojourned" — it is already known that Eisav and Yaakov were both given great rectifications to accomplish. Yaakov was to rectify the rectifications of holiness — which is from the right side. And Eisav — from the left side — was to subdue the Sitra Achra. When Eisav went astray, Yaakov needed to complete [the work] on his behalf. In this secret he went to Lavan's house to subdue the Sitra Achra. And this is what he hinted by saying: "With Lavan I have sojourned" — so that Eisav should not think that because he himself did not rectify, the Tikkun was thereby lacking — for he too knew how to complete it: going to Lavan's house — the stronghold of the Sitra Achra — and subduing it.

There is furthermore another reason he mentioned the defeat of Lavan — because whoever wishes to subdue the Sitra Achra, nothing subdues her so thoroughly as reminding her of a defeat she has already suffered once. Therefore now, when he needed to subdue the Sitra Achra on account of Eisav, he reminded her of a previous defeat that was accomplished in Lavan's house — in order to subdue her now.

"And until now" — the Sages taught: Eisav falls only through the hand of the sons of Rachel. And the reason for Rachel specifically and not Leah: Eisav is already known to stand in the secret of the serpent, and he sought to maintain the first blemish — made through the serpent who deposited the impurity of keri in Chava. And since he perpetuates the first blemish made in Malchus, therefore it is one from the aspect of Malchus specifically who will come — one of the sons of Rachel, who stands in the secret of Malchus specifically — to subdue him. Therefore a son of Rachel specifically and not of Leah — for in the place where there is the blemish, from there precisely the vengeance upon Eisav will emerge. MS A
"And it came to pass as her soul departed — for she died — and she called his name Ben-Oni; but his father called him Binyamin…" [Genesis 35:18]

One must understand: what need did Yaakov have to change the name that Rachel had called him? After all, mothers call their children by names according to their circumstances and experiences. And why specifically this name "Binyamin"? It is already known that Binyamin was in the aspect of Malchus. Therefore Rachel called him Ben-Oni — as it says: "my strength and the first of my vigor [אוני]" [Genesis 49:3] — meaning the first drop that issued from him, as the Sages said: he never experienced keri in all his days. So Rachel called him Ben-Oni — meaning: son of my strength. But because Yaakov knew that children born from the side of the Nukva [the feminine / Malchus] do not survive — as they said concerning the Shunamite woman whose son Elisha revived — because they are from the side of Din, and the Sitra Achra prosecutes and opposes them. Therefore Yaakov went back and gave him another name — not desiring this specific name. By calling him Binyamin — he anchored his root under the right side (yamin), so that the Sitra Achra would not oppose him — as written in the Zohar. Not under the left, as the name Ben-Oni implied — for Nukva is connected to the left — but "son of the right" (ben yamin), and then the Sitra Achra has no share in him at all. MS H
"And his brothers said to him: Will you then reign…?" [Genesis 37:8–10]

The tribes' intention was not evil, G-d forbid. But the matter is: Yosef's level was in Yesod, and from this aspect he was able to reign — for Yesod is a comprehensive Sefira as is known, and a king too must have a comprehensive soul. This is the secret of Shaul who reigned and who was at the level of Yesod. And this is the secret of Mashiach ben Yosef who will reign in the future — he is in Yesod. For all who stand in Yesod are granted a certain rulership, since it is a comprehensive soul. But the tribes considered that the time had not yet come for this — because Yosef's level above — which is Yesod — had not yet been fully rectified, for it was blemished by the sparks of keri of Adam the first man, as is known. And to rectify this, it was necessary to go through the exile of Egypt. And this is what the tribes said to him: "Will you reign…or will you rule over us?" — you think to complete now the illumination of Yesod called "ruler" (moshel) — that is impossible, for it is not yet properly rectified. And so it was: even though he reigned, it was not a complete reign — he was king under the hand of Pharaoh, called "his viceroy" (mishneh lo) — for he was still in the hand of the Sitra Achra.

He dreamed two dreams alluding to kingship. There is a secret here — the Sages taught: a dream that is repeated comes to pass. A dream is something revealed to a person that must come to be. And sometimes there are obstacles — if it is something good, the Sitra Achra is jealous of it and prevents it from descending below with its prosecution. The Tikkun is to reveal that same thing a second time — and then the obstacles dissipate and are not sustained. Therefore a repeated dream comes to pass. Here he dreamed twice to confirm his kingship — for the first time his kingship was revealed, and so that the Sitra Achra would not delay it, he dreamed again to remove its power. And even after the second dream there were many prosecutions — but they did not prevail, and he later reigned. This is the power of the second dream — to remove the power of prosecution so that it has no standing or validity.

Therefore the first time Yosef did not go to tell his father about the dream — so that his father would not rebuke him. For the power of Yaakov's speech was great, and had he rebuked him the first time about the dream, he might have nullified it. But since he dreamed the second time, there was no longer such fear — for it had already been strengthened. And he dreamed: "I and your mother" — and the Sages said: there is no dream without some empty words. The dream — as already stated — has its secret in the descent of Netzach and Hod of the vision that descends below clothed in Yetzira, as is known. Therefore there is no dream without some empty words — for in Atzilus it is said: "no evil shall dwell with You" [Psalms 5:5]. But in Bri'a, Yetzira, Asiya — there the Sitra Achra stands. Therefore the dream, from the aspect of its being in Bri'a-Yetzira-Asiya — since the Sitra Achra stands there — empty words flow from there. But what flows from the holy Sefiros — all of it is truth. MS A

"And she removed her widow's garments from upon her and covered herself with a veil and wrapped herself and sat at the entrance to Einayim which is on the road to Timnah — for she saw that Shelah had grown and she had not been given to him as a wife." [Genesis 38:14]

Come and see: when the time of redemption draws near, the Shechina rises before the King. She then receives all her power to remove from herself all garments of mourning. This is: ותסר ("and she removed") — which is ת״ו ס״ר: the ת״ו — the mark of Atik Yomin (the Ancient of Days) traced upon her; ס״ר — these are the ten Divine Names given to her to sweeten her. During the exile it is said: "She has become like a widow" [Lamentations 1:1]. But this is only externally — for there it is: "all her friends have betrayed her" — the Messiahs who wander after the Shechina — these are the "garments of her widowhood." But when the time of Mashiach comes and he dons "garments of salvation," then also the Shechina: "and she removed the garments of her widowhood from upon her."

Yet she does not remain bare — rather: "and she covered herself with a veil" — this is the pure veil with the addition of a יוד — for below it is צניף (turban) and above it is צעיף (veil). "The fear of Hashem is pure" [Psalms 19:10].

Come and see: the Shechina in exile walks in Bri'a, where the level of Metatron is. And then the King — her husband — becomes as her father-in-law. And this is Yehuda — as the father-in-law of Tamar. Therefore the Tikkun can only come through the agency of Ima Ila'a (the Supernal Mother) — and this is: the initial letters of ב׳גדי א׳למנותה מ׳עליה ו׳תכס spell באמו — "through his mother" — for through the power of Ima, the Mother of the King, begins the rectification. For she is not in the [state of] dormita (slumber) — for Ima does not extend beyond Atzilus. And therefore…all is from the side of the King. And the final letters of ב׳גדי א׳למנותה מ׳עליה spell יה״ה, and with the ו׳ of ו׳תכס, the rectification returns to the Name הו״י. And this ו׳ of ו׳תכס completes the rectification on two sides — to Ima in the King, and to the King in the Shechina.

Then: "and she wrapped herself" — ותתעלף = תעלת וף — for through the joy of it all, the Shechina rises. This is the drum of Miriam — as it is written: "And Miriam took…the drum in her hand and all the women went out after her with drums and dancing" [Exodus 15:20] — and she is Miriam and she is רמים (she elevates) — when the Shechina rises, all the worlds rise with her.

And all this comes about through the power of…[Abba] who is "opening" (pesach) — for through his power the preparation for the divine union is given. Therefore: "and she sat at the opening [pesach]" — and this is pesach with a segol vowel, which is the "opening" that is resh, and the 24 adornments of the bride — totaling 30 — therefore פתח and not פתח [a kabbalistic nuance of the vowel pointing]. "At the opening of the eyes [einayim]" — indeed, these are the two supernal eyes — Abba and Ima. Abba is the secret of the eye of providence; Ima — seventy sparks of Elokim. When does this occur? When the time of the rectification of the "eight leaders of men" approaches — in the secret of the eight faces — "which is on the road to Timnah."

And why all this? Because: "she saw that Shelah had grown" — this is Moshe — שילה — for while he is small he is "hers" (שלה), but when he grows he becomes שילה. Then it is the time to give "the woman to her husband" — who is Moshe — in the secret of "the master of the matron." "She saw that Shelah had grown, and she had not been given to him as a wife" — and therefore: "she sat at the opening of the eyes" — in the secret of the seventy rectifications wrought in exile — through whose power a complete and eternal redemption will be revealed. MS D
"And Pharaoh said…after G-d has made known to you all this…" [Genesis 41:39–42]

Yosef embodies Yesod, and in Yesod the Sefira of Da'as (knowledge) is clothed, as is known. And at that time, the knowledge that Yosef possessed was because the Sefira of Da'as shone upon him. This is: "after G-d has made known [hodi'a]" — hodi'a specifically. And since the Sefira of Da'as is none other than the comprehensive union of Chachma and Bina together, one who receives from Da'as receives from Chachma and Bina as well. Therefore: "there is none as discerning and wise as you."

And this is what it said above: "Can one be found like this man in whom the spirit of G-d is?" — this is the holy spirit (ruach ha-kodesh) that flows from the Sefira of Da'as — for from there the holy spirit flows, as it says: da'as zeh ruach ha-kodesh. And it says: "after G-d [Elokim] has made known" — this Elokim specifically is Ima, who shone upon him — for from her the seventy languages are learned, as is known.

There is here a secret that the Sages taught: "the scoffer seeks wisdom and finds none" etc. — the Sitra Achra, even if it sometimes has some hold in holiness, it is only up to Ima and no further. Therefore the sages of Egypt are told: "the scoffer seeks wisdom and finds none" [Proverbs 14:6] — they thought to grasp wisdom (Chachma) but could not attain it. But Yosef — not only did he attain the level of Abba, which is Chachma, but he also attained the level of Arich Anpin. This is: "and knowledge comes easily to the discerning" [Proverbs 14:6] — this is the supernal Da'as — the source of all Da'as — which is the mazla (destiny-flow) of Arich Anpin. For Yosef it was easy to attain even this supernal illumination — since he had attained the illumination of Bina through the secret of the seventy languages. Therefore he is called "discerning" (navon), as the Sages said: "knowledge comes easy to the discerning — this is Yosef." He attained also the illumination of this supernal Da'as, which is nothing other than the union of Abba and Ima. Therefore this supernal Da'as shone upon him — for this was the distinction of Yosef who stands in the dimension of Yesod: to attain the illumination of the Dikna of Arich Anpin — which is also the purpose of Yesod above: to receive its power from so exalted a source.

Pharaoh said to him: "You shall be over my house" — it is already known that all the vitality and sustenance of the klipa comes from holiness. Yet it thinks itself the ruler — thinking that holiness is almost compelled to sustain it, and that it reigns. Therefore now, at the beginning of the rectification, the Holy One wished to reveal to the world — that all vitality of the klipa comes only from holiness. Therefore: "You shall be over my house." But since the rectification was not yet complete, it says: "Only by the throne shall I be greater than you" — for Pharaoh wished to reign — because the Sitra Achra still had some dominion.

"And Pharaoh removed his ring" — when souls are in exile the Shechina is with them. When Yosef was within the Sitra Achra — in prison — the Shechina stood with him. But now that Yosef was beginning to ascend, the Shechina also rose. Therefore Pharaoh removed his ring — for when it is the time of rectification, the evil angel surely responds "Amen" against his will, and performs various acts for the Tikkun even without thinking. The Holy One placed in Pharaoh's heart to remove the ring — to allude to the ascent of Malchus through Yesod, therefore it was given to Yosef who stands in Yesod.

Furthermore: the Holy One wished to draw upon Yosef the illumination of the five Partzufim [the five divine "faces/configurations" — Arich Anpin, Abba, Ima, Ze'ir Anpin, Nukva]. Therefore He placed in Pharaoh's heart to perform all these acts. Their order, from below to above: first — Malchus, in the secret of the giving of the ring. Then the illumination of Ze'ir Anpin — in the dimension of: "and he clothed him in garments of fine linen [shesh]" — from the side of Ze'ir Anpin, as already noted. Then the illumination of Ima — in the dimension of: "and placed a golden chain about his neck" — for gold is in Ima. Then also the illumination of Chachma — in the dimension of: אַבְרֵךְ (Avrech) — אב בחכמה ("father in wisdom") as the Sages explained — this is the illumination of Abba. And finally also Arich Anpin, to complete him as he should be — and this is when he called him "Tzafnas Pane'ach" — which means: the one who interprets concealed and hidden matters — and this is in Arich Anpin, where things stand in great concealment. And such was the power of Yosef to complete. MS A
"These are the sons of Leah…thirty-three." [Genesis 46:15]

But when you count them individually you find only thirty-two. The Sages said here: this is Yocheved, who was born between the [Egyptian border-]walls. Israel were going now into exile, and the Holy One preceded the cure to the wound. He desired that the light of the redemption be revealed before the exile. Ima is the redeemer of Israel, as it says: "I am Hashem your G-d" [Exodus 20:2] — Anochi is Ima, as is known. Yocheved — as already explained — is in Ima. Therefore when they went to Egypt specifically, she was born there — to indicate that precisely in their going to Egypt, the light of Ima was prepared to redeem Israel — to precede the cure to the wound. And "between the walls" specifically — the Sitra Achra is like an iron wall, a partition separating Israel from their Father in Heaven. And as long as Nukva alone illuminates, sometimes G-d forbid the handmaid inherits from her mistress. But when Ima illuminates — this handmaid is subdued. Therefore she was born between the walls — to subdue that wall, which is the wicked Nukva [of the klipa]. And since [the klipa] is divided into two feminine aspects, corresponding to what exists in holiness, therefore — "between the walls" specifically. MS A
